wins.need: Recharging fast from the wall before or between outages
wins.claim: The Solar Lab timed it recharging faster from the wall than the Bluetti Elite 300
wins.figure: The Solar Lab: a fully drained unit reached 100% in exactly 2 h on a household outlet. The same reviewer reports about 2 h 45 min for the Elite 300 (3,014 Wh).

wins.need: Buying a 3 kWh, 3,600 W EcoFlow on Amazon
wins.claim: On Amazon it costs less than EcoFlow's own DELTA 3000 Gen4, which has the same capacity and output
wins.figure: Arithmetic: Amazon shows $1,299 for the DELTA 3 Ultra (B0FQVBFLHL) and $1,699 for the DELTA 3000 Gen4 (B0HLSH5GWK), a $400 gap. Both are 3,072 Wh and 3,600 W.
wins.who: Arithmetic on Amazon prices read with amzcheck

wins.need: Keeping a NAS, PC or router online through a blackout
wins.figure: 10 ms auto-switch. Rated at 25 dB or less at a 600 W load.

weak.claim: At EcoFlow's own store, its sibling the DELTA 3000 Gen4 costs the same and is lighter, with more solar input
weak.figure: Both are $1,299 at us.ecoflow.com. The Gen4 is 57.3 lb with 1,000 W solar input (Popular Science, Stan Horaczek, Nov 4 2026). The Ultra is 72 lb with 800 W solar (The Solar Lab).

weak.claim: It smoked when connected to more solar than it is rated for
weak.figure: The Solar Lab: on a 1,000 W array it 'made a strange sound and smoked', twice, and did not shut off when over-paneled. Rated solar input is 800 W.

weak.claim: Its solar input is low for the battery size, and it has no battery expansion
weak.figure: 800 W solar, not expandable (The Solar Lab). The Ultra Plus takes 1,600 W of solar and expands to 3–11 kWh (EcoFlow).

weak.claim: High idle draw and lower efficiency than its Plus sibling
weak.figure: The Solar Lab measured about 22 W idle and about 82% efficiency, and called the idle draw 'a little high'. The same lab measured about 85% on the Ultra Plus.

weak.claim: EcoFlow's Smart Generator cannot auto start and stop with it
weak.figure: EcoFlow: Smart Generator 3000 automatic start-stop 'is only compatible with DELTA 3, DELTA 3 Plus and DELTA 3 Ultra Plus'

weak.claim: Heavy, with no built-in light and a basic display
weak.figure: 72 lb. The Solar Lab says it 'technically passes' its lift test 'but just barely'.

weak.claim: Costs more per Wh than the Bluetti Elite 300
weak.figure: Arithmetic: $1,299 / 3,072 Wh = $0.423/Wh, against $1,199 / 3,014 Wh = $0.398/Wh for the Elite 300

The ASIN is filled in, but the main session must confirm the seller is EcoFlow or Amazon before publishing. If it is not, set asin to null.

Duplicate Amazon listings: B0FR8PJ8KK has the same title, $1,299 price and 82 ratings, probably a variation of the same family. B0FT32MCM9 ('EF ECOFLOW Delta 3 Ultra Portable Power Station', $1,299, 410 ratings) has a shorter title, so I could not tell whether it is the bare unit or a bundle.

Spec rows from the maker's spec table (weight, dimensions, solar voltage range, outlet types, cycle life): the us.ecoflow.com product page returned HTTP 429 to WebFetch all session, the ecoflow.com/us spec and support URLs returned 404, and the manuals.plus manual returned 403.
